signatures.description: Uses Windows utilities for basic Windows functionality

T1053.long: Utilities such as at and schtasks, along with the Windows Task Scheduler, can be used to schedule programs or scripts to be executed at a date and time. A task can also be scheduled on a remote system, provided the proper authentication is met to use RPC and file and printer sharing is turned on. Scheduling a task on a remote system typically required being a member of the Administrators group on the the remote system.

strings: Our main job is to make the quality average custom PCB board 9% higher. Here you can get 1-30 layers of FR-4 PCB, including  FR4, Aluminum ,Rogers, Taconic series,Arlon series
They are widely used in electronic products such as control systems, telecommunications, consumer electronics and power supplies, and robotics.

At the same time, the products are widely sold to the United States, Europe, Russia and other countries and regions.
We sincerely hope to establish long-term good relations of cooperation with you.
If you are interested, please reply to the email and we will provide company information and samples for certification.
